meta_description: Western Auto serving Wendell - auto repair that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of auto repair in Wendell.
hero_lede: Auto repair shop in Wendell. Recent jobs are on the photos page.
explore_h2: Tell us what it is doing and we will take it from there
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the car
about_p1: We handle auto repair for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, exhaust and underbody. We work out of Wendell and the towns around it.
area_h2: Serving Wendell and the towns nearby
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on

reviews.author: watch stuff
reviews.text: If I could give more than 5 stars I would. I was a walk in on a Friday morning and they fixed some loose parts on my CV axle in less than 20 minutes! The staff was super friendly as well

reviews.author: Christina Young
reviews.text: I have been going here for two years now having gotten several different services done and I will not go anywhere else now. The prices are unbeatable and the work done is honest and exceptional! Thank you!

reviews.author: Sherri Barham
reviews.text: Oh my goodness…The Green Egg has arrive in Wendell. Best marketing. I stopped just because they had the giant Green Egg on their building. The staff was delightful and helpful. They have a great display and selection of Green Eggs. They have a full selection of accessories etc. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rob Lee
reviews.text: Much more than a parts store. Their services range from inspection to motor repair. I took them my wife's Mercedes Benz for a new starter Friday at 100pm and they delivered it back to my house by 1000am the next morning. Best Auto Repair Service in Wendell. I have been a happy customer for 35 years!!

reviews.author: Lisa Roose
reviews.text: The service is quick, you have a very comfortable waiting room with rocking chairs and a tv, you get so relaxed you don't even mind waiting! The staff is phenomenal, pleasant and friendly and very accommodating

reviews.author: brenda lewis
reviews.text: Good place to take your car. I took my car there a couple of times. The work they do is great. Hayden if I am spelling it right did a great job and any problems you can bring the car back

reviews.author: Deb West
reviews.text: I took my car there to be looked at knowing that my RPM gauge was something wrong with it (thanks to my neighbor, found out it was my Crankshaft sensor,. I was told there was nothing wrong. This is after my car stopping on I-40 and couldn't accelerate RPM at zero but engine was fine. I will not ever take my car or will not reccommend anyone else. Maybe for an oil change.

reviews.author: Cyrus S
reviews.text: Took my truck in for oil change and tire rotation. Came home and noticed 2 small dings and paint scrape on driver door; had oil leak/drops for 2 days and had two greasy hand prints on the hood. I Called and spoke to the owner who didn't apologize and all he said was " I tell you what i want you to do, come tomorrow and I look and see how we could have done that and then we talk"! Needless to say I didn't go because a professional businessman would not address a customer in that manner and I'm too busy to waste my time going there just to hear a no. So, I just decided to write it off as bad experience and needless to say won't take our cars there anymore. This was my experience. Good luck.

reviews.author: Ron Brown
reviews.text: I can't recommend Mike and the crew at Western Auto enough! Not only do they do great work, but they care about their customers and treat them like neighbors. My family and I have been taking our car to them for two and a half years. They've always done great work at a fair price and go out of their way to help us. They've even given my wife and kids a ride home so they wouldn't have to wait for the repairs to be made! I won't go to any other mechanic shop while Western Auto is still in business.

reviews.author: Andy Tuttle
reviews.text: I had an accident and had to have my car towed there. Hayden called to get the story and was extremely accommodating. Storage fees were fair! I will be back.

reviews.author: Olivia Johnson
reviews.text: If I could give them 10 Stars I would!! Great customer service every time I walk in. They do excellent work and their prices are fare. Cameron in particular is always extra friendly but everyone is always super helpful and seem to know their stuff. Even though the shop is a bit out of the way for me it's definitely worth the drive. I came for brake replacement and a tire I'll be back in a couple weeks for an oil change. If you pick this place you won't be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Anthony Reid
reviews.text: Always a pleasure here. The staff are friendly and quite knowledgeable. I have brought several vehicles here for repair and have been tr rated with respect and honesty.

reviews.author: Gabriel schulz
reviews.text: Will 100% come here again to get my truck serviced! Very affordable and honest. Felt very welcomed and respected when talking with the head mechanic.

reviews.author: Yes R
reviews.text: Friendly service, good prices. Excellent mechanics. Wash right in for my safety inspection. And a great selection of just what you need.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.text: I took my vehicle here for a state inspection and had a great experience! Staff are nice and helpful. They got the inspection done in less than 10 minutes. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Emory O'Dell
reviews.text: Good people. I have bought tires for my wife and mom here several times good price and fairly quick. I have other services done along reasonably priced and nice people

reviews.author: Cierra Puett
reviews.text: This place is awesome. Their customer service is always the treat-you-like-a-friend kind you can never find anymore these days. We live locally so this place is wonderful for quick stops for hardware and automotive supplies to save us a trip further into Knightdale or Raleigh. Recently found out they do state auto inspections, too, which just adds to our reasons for continuing to give them our business. Thank y'all for running such an trustworthy shop with stellar customer service! We appreciate you.

reviews.author: Martha Hinely
reviews.text: Great folks to work with. They have fit me in as a drive in customer several times. If they cannot get to the repair that day they will set an appointment or give you a quote to consider your options. I have found the to be very reasonably priced compared to other shops also.

reviews.author: Elisabeth Clinton
reviews.text: This is the only place I like bringing my vehicles to. They fit you into their schedule, not the other way around. They're always kind and work with you no matter your level of auto knowledge and I've never had to worry about being taken advantage of.

reviews.author: John C
reviews.text: Great small town hardware store, auto parts, and auto maintenance services. The owner, Mike Apple, is "salt of the earth," and a genuinely good person with whom to do business. His prices are fair, the services are of high quality, and I trust him and his staff implicitly. Whenever my teenage daughter needs an oil change, inspection, or anything auto related, I send her to Western Auto; fantastic service and people.

reviews.author: Private Caller
reviews.text: Needed my yearly inspection on two of my vehicles. The staff did a good job communicative and quick. Definitely will visit them again and spend time exploring their store.

reviews.author: Joel Cocker
reviews.text: A little bit of everything with very friendly workers. All tires we have gotten for both vehicles have been great and very fair priced. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Bruce Beck
reviews.text: Always GREAT service here! Mike and his team do an excellent job! Keep your money local and support small business in the immediate area.

reviews.author: Brad
reviews.text: I get all my cars serviced here. Best place around for honest quality work for sure! Thank you to all the employee's that make this place great!

reviews.author: J.R. Martinez
reviews.text: I get my inspections here every year. With multiple vehicles is nice to truck a business that understands your needs.

reviews.author: Gregory Simone
reviews.text: This is the only place in the WHOLE state I will bring my vehicles to. Mike,Hayden and rest of staff are top notch. Can’t recommend these guys enough. Great people!

reviews.author: Becky L
reviews.text: Amazing service! I had my engine replaced & Hayden was very helpful! My jeep is running better than before. I 10000% recommend this shop for car repairs!

reviews.author: Lenny Perry
reviews.text: Great place to get your annual Vehicle Inspection. They also have a great mechanic named John, a very experienced mechanic. This Western Auto also has auto parts, accesories, some electrical and plumbing supplies, lawn and garden supplies, and seasonal products. The owner and his staff are friendly and knowledgeable about what they have in the store.

reviews.author: Juan B
reviews.text: I like coming here because the staff are knowledgeable. The best part is that i dont have to empty my car of valuables before coming in because the people here are trustworthy. I have left my ipad and money and nothing has ever gone missing. And the service is quick. They have never tried to sell me a random repair or product.

reviews.author: Roulette Thomas
reviews.text: Staff originally told me ten minutes. Then 2 hours had went by finally had got service from this older woman that was very unpleasant and was mad that she had to get up from having lunch. After it was in the air if they could help me or not they had taken my chainsaw after me only asking them to sharpen the blade. 24 hours later they had taken someone else's chainsaw in switched out blades, did not sharpen it . Then after checking out the lady was man handling my card. Never doing business again

reviews.author: Jay Ferrell
reviews.text: Great service my car wouldnt crank , called up there and spoke with john and he told me to get it towed there so i did that and a few days later my car was up and running. Very great and experienced people thank you i highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Ihrie Knott
reviews.text: They do not advertise "body shop" business for their store but it is superb! They are artists in this. Looked better when I got it back than before I was hit. Honest, personable, quick. Nothing to compare!

reviews.author: Carol Sanson
reviews.text: Until recently I never knew there was an auto repair place as part of the Western Auto in Wendell. Two weeks ago my husband and I needed tires and purchase them there. Service was great. Price was amazing. #shoplocal

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.text: Quick service and reasonable price, before we took the car there, we call another auto shop for a quote which was almost 50% more. Will use them going forwrd.

reviews.author: Brad Dawson
reviews.text: Great experience and atmosphere. The store is older but great people. Reminded me of my childhood when my Grandfather worked at a Western Auto.

reviews.author: Ernest Wright
reviews.text: These guys are the best. Been doing business with them for years. Never a problem. Alway great service at a good price.

reviews.author: Joe Monday
reviews.text: Always enjoy the great service from Mike and staff. They know how to make you feel important and get the job done.

reviews.author: Walter Moreland
reviews.text: The service was great, and everyone was caring. I've been going there for years, and I will continue too.

reviews.author: Jonathan Collins
reviews.text: Best vehicle service in and around Wake County. They explain exactly what your car needs without any hassles

reviews.author: Queta Wright
reviews.text: This is my go to place for all my vehicle needs. They have great customer service and great attention to detail!

reviews.author: Jennifer Bruner
reviews.text: Awesome staff that do great work at a reasonable price in a reasonable amount of time. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Rob Wilson
reviews.text: I'm glad I started coming to the store for my automotive and home supply needs.. The staff in the repair shop are Very polite and professional.

reviews.author: brice hall
reviews.text: John and Mike do a great job at very reasonable prices. Great home town store with super friendly people and great service.

reviews.author: Cheryl King
reviews.text: Fantastic! They always have what you need, and give great advice and service. You can always trust them, they are honorable.

reviews.author: Thomas Smithwick
reviews.text: Stopped in to see what they had and found a very well equipped hardware store and very helpful staff.
